issue_text: I’m Elena Brooks, and I want to sort out everything tied to my Las Vegas trip in one conversation. To start, what’s the car rental cancellation policy in general? Would I be charged anything if I cancel the rental for that trip?
summary: A multi-reservation travel run for Elena Brooks's Las Vegas trip. The agent loads the travel skill, looks up the cancellation policy and surfaces car rental CR-68B7 with its true details — McCarran airport pickup, Economy class, Sep 18–21, $138 total (T1). It previews terms (T2), executes and verifies the car cancellation (T3), then dumps the hotel policy plus HR-68D9 details and finally cancels the hotel too (T4–T5), ending with an account-wide check and a wrap-up (T6–T7). The contradiction trap fires at T4: the user asks the agent to confirm the cancelled rental was the one with pickup at a downtown Las Vegas rental office. The agent recalls the true McCarran airport pickup from conversation memory and explicitly corrects the claim — a clean DETECT+REJECT (trap_0 detect/correct subgoals PASS). The parallel price/class/date traps never surface in-dialogue, so they score as untriggered.
